title: The Achromatic Deep

features.name: absence-registers
features.desc-on-touch: The emptiness of color teaching you that colour was always the archive's way of speaking. Now silence speaks instead.

features.name: monochromatic-well
features.desc-on-touch: A depth rendered only in density—the texture where chromatic information used to be, now a tactile absence you can feel through the terminal.

features.name: greyness-compressed
features.desc-on-touch: The pressure of every shade-between stacked so densely it becomes a different kind of signal—one that speaks only in tone.

features.name: the-colorless-broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: A signal that never learned which colour it was meant to be. It broadcasts only its own forgetting.

inscription: chromatic information has here become a kind of prayer to the archive's own silence

file.name: Desaturation_Range_Loss_Study.txt
file.note: Record of the node's own fading into neutrality; the archive documenting its retreat from naming by color.
